name: Koll the Forgemaster
description: The greatest of the dwarves, the only one who can work Tyrite, who was making the Sword of the Realms and was pushed into his forge by Tibalt.

description_citations.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Disguised as Valki, Tibalt visits Koll the Forgemaster, who refuses to hand over the Sword of the Realms, and pushes him into his forge.
timeline.quote: so Tibalt did the realms a favor and pushed the obnoxious dwarf right into his own forge

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.
